label: Ghost in the Ledger
summary: A client in an expensive coat wants you to find a missing data courier. The courier wants to stay missing.
title: Ghost in the Ledger
description: A data courier vanished between two towers with a ledger that three corporations would kill for. Your client says they just want their friend back.

chapterOutlines.title: The Client
chapterOutlines.outline: Take the job, and notice what the client leaves out.

chapterOutlines.title: Downtown
chapterOutlines.outline: Follow the courier's trail through the street markets.

chapterOutlines.title: The Ledger
chapterOutlines.outline: Find the courier, and decide who gets the ledger.

scene.location: A rented office above a noodle bar on Kessler Street
scene.summary: Rain on the window, a broken ceiling fan, and a client in an expensive coat who has not taken it off.

openThreads: Who is the client really working for?

npcs.name: Mika Sato
npcs.description: Knows everyone worth knowing and charges for each introduction. Owes you one favor, and hates it.
goals: Stay neutral while three corporations go to war
abilities: Can find anyone in the city, for a price
